Reuse economics depend on amortized verification/repair/maintenance at f=10, not hit rate alone; distill+auditor overhead and probe cost can dominate hit savings if precision low, requiring honest sum-counters cost (resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps) with |rho_shuffled|<0.20 sanity — prior used to require QCR and forbid n*3200 bijective costs.

Generic single-prefix common-prefix/suffix parameterization is fragile across orthogonal alias families (query-param vs path vs header ApiKey vs body JSON vs auth); family-specific slot induction and field-path relevance filtering (url/body.*/headers.*) reduce over-parameterization — prior justifies durably fixed kernel and single-family zero-overlap pilot before broadening.

Measurement traps recur: Laplace smoothing inflates H(Y|Z,A) with cell count, SHA256 truncation destroys AX info, deterministic bootstrap at ceiling 1.0 hides sensitivity ordering, per-node SQLite under round-robin breaks session validity — prior guides demand for trajectory-grouped permutation, non-hash-truncated AX up to 5k, and shared WAL+sticky hash.

Exploration breadth (WebGym 300k, BrowserGym diverse sites) unblocks reuse more than another parameterization tuning when 10/10 concentration persists; cognitive reset asking what fresh-slate best problem would be reveals higher-value neglected claims — prior motivates frontier tool-bypass and intel relaxed Gate0 sampling over repeating alias-OOD.
